game: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games
project: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Games native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Plays the 100 m at 60 fps, no graphics errors seen. Tested on Windows 11 and on the Linux mini PC by playing into the first real scene (mini PC: the 100 m from line-up to the awards ceremony, 55.3 fps). With the current runtime version the game was started and run through its menus again on the mini PC (no stops, frame times as before); the scene named here was played with the version before. Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
